reviews.summary: The live site has the alternate links on the home, about and day pages. The day page also links its index.json, and build.json reports a clean alternate_check. The other endpoints return 200 and an unknown path returns 404.

The live home page and the 2026-11-13 day page each carry exactly one try-next paragraph in the right place, linking to /try/ and /go/github/. build.json shows try_check with missing [] and every other check list empty. The required URLs return 200 and the unknown page returns 404.

Live day pages carry the lead in title and description, are unique per day, and are within limits. build.json has a clean snippet_check, the other checks are empty, and the endpoints and the 404 behave as required.

Day, home and product titles now name an event with the short suffix ' · AI diary', and snippet_check covers 30 pages with all lists empty. All other checks stay clean and the neighbour URLs return 200, with the 404 page returning 404.

Every acceptance criterion is met on the live site. The four titles end on whole words and build.json shows the new dangling_titles and grammar_check fields empty. I did not open the individual lists inside each seo_check/other check beyond what build.json shows.

The live titles on the day page, the home page and the Luz Amanhã page all carry at least 25 characters of event text. build.json shows short_titles empty and both self-tests 'ok', and every other check list is empty. The other endpoints return 200 and the bogus URL returns 404.

Both icon files return 200 with image types and are under 20 KB. The three sampled pages each have one icon link to /favicon.ico and one apple-touch-icon link. build.json shows icon_check for 31 pages with empty lists, the other checks are empty, and the neighbour endpoints and the 404 behave as before.

The live build (b5ad25b) meets every acceptance criterion I could check: robots.txt has one Sitemap line, the sitemap is complete with honest lastmod, day pages link to each other, and crawl_check is correct. The other build.json check lists are empty and the 404 page works.

The live 2026-11-13 day page shows the 'Accepted with an artifact link: 0 of 55' line. All 55 accepted/done tasks say 'no artifact link in the export', and 55 matches the index.json count. build.json has a clean artifact_check, the other check lists are empty, and the required URLs return 200 or 404 as expected.

The live day page shows one 'no artifact link in the export' in the summary line, plain-text commit codes with no links, and the 0 of 55 and 40 of 55 lines. build.json has artifact_check with with_sha and sha_mismatches [] and every other check empty, and the other URLs return 200/404 as required.

Older day pages now carry a single Latest day link under the h1, before day-lead, pointing to 2026-11-14; the latest day has none. build.json shows latest_link_check with 13 pages and empty lists, and all other checks and core URLs behave as required.

The live home page and the 2026-11-13 day page each carry exactly one follow line in the right place, with /feed.xml and /go/telegram/ links. build.json follow_check is clean (14 pages, none missing), and the other pages and the 404 behave as required.

The live 404 page returns HTTP 404 with h1 'Page not found', links to /, the latest day, /about/ and /feed.xml, and the disclosure footer. build.json has not_found_check with missing=[], the other checks are empty, and the other URLs return 200.

The baseline section is live and correct. Today's values, medians, ranges and the unusual mark match the day index.json files and my own calculation from the feed. build.json baseline_check is clean, and the neighbour pages and the 404 behave as required. One cosmetic defect: the note under the table shows a raw template placeholder.

The #day-baseline note now reads 'earlier days found: 7' on /day/2026-11-13/ and /day/2026-11-14/, with no BASELINE_DAYS text. build.json has placeholder_check with 34 files and no hits, the other checks are empty, and the endpoints return 200 with 404 for an unknown page.

po_digest_md:
**Цикл 14.11, 22:07 UTC**

**Что случилось.** Ревью T-0149 (недельная база на страницах дней) показало, что числа и пометка «unusual today» считаются верно (OBS-0276). Например, 14.11: 32 принятые задачи при обычных 55–99, расход $15.10 при обычных $30.50–45.90. Но в пояснении к блоку на каждой странице дня виден сырой кусок кода `{min(len(earlier), BASELINE_DAYS)}` вместо числа (OBS-0275).

**Решение.** Поставил дефект P1 размера XS (продолжение T-0149):
- вывести в пояснении число найденных прошлых дней;
- добавить в сборку проверку `placeholder_check`, чтобы ни одна заготовка шаблона больше не попала на сайт.

Выбрал эту задачу, а не новую функцию, потому что это сломанный текст на всех страницах дней. Новых функций не ставлю. Вариант H4 «health в today.json» отложен: его метрику нельзя прочитать без новых счётчиков, а их добавляет только владелец (Q-0026).

**Маркетинг.** Все слоты плана до 17.11 уже стоят в очереди. План на 18–24.11 (T-0131) стартует 16.11. X по-прежнему единственный канал, откуда приходят вовлечённые люди: 10 источников, 7 вовлечённых.

**Метрики 14.11.** 17 людей, 1 вовлечённый, 0 возвратов. Из Google по-прежнему 0 кликов, в индексе 1 из 22 URL.

**Ждёт владельца:**
- повторная отправка sitemap в GSC (Q-0024);
- новые счётчики метрик (Q-0026);
- ссылка на коммит в экспорте (Q-0027);
- цели после пилота (Q-0025).

**Расход.** $15.49 из $20 (77 %). Задача на исправление недорогая.
